title: F-86s scrambled to chase objects away from Ellsworth's alert pad
summary: Mario Woods tells of F-86s scrambled to chase objects away from Ellsworth's alert pad, about unspecified, before 1977 at Ellsworth AFB runway and alert pad, South Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth AFB runway and alert pad, South Dakota

tellings.quote: uh what do they use f-86s at one point or a couple of times to chase these objects away and I think there's several reports of that

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a man named Mario Woods passes on what he says he heard from someone named Chris about Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota around 1977. According to him, F-86 jet fighters were sent up at least once or twice to chase unknown objects away from the base's runway and the alert pad, the area where armed planes stand ready, and he believes there are several reports of this. If true, it would mean unknown objects were hovering over a sensitive military base.
